intent.title: Preview the page without editor chrome
steps: Build a page with a Button that has a hover state and a Details element.
Hover the button, open the details, switch to Phone.
expected: Preview hides docks, selection, guides and handles; only a slim bar with the breakpoint switcher, Exit preview and Export remains.
The page renders exactly like the export: hover states apply and details open; links do not navigate the editor away.
Escape or Ctrl+Enter exits preview and restores the previous selection and zoom.
Preview never changes the document JSON.

intent.title: Embed custom HTML
steps: Insert an Embed and paste third-party widget markup with a script.
expected: The markup is stored as-is and shown sandboxed on the editing canvas, where its scripts never run.
The export writes it verbatim at its place; Layers marks it as an embed.

intent.title: Light, dark and system theme
steps: Choose Theme > Light, then Dark, then System.
With System chosen, switch the OS/browser colour scheme emulation.
expected: The editor chrome switches its colour tokens; the page inside the iframe keeps its own colours.
The choice is stored in the preferences store and restored after reload.
